title: MI51015: Reclamation And Rehabilitation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Classification of mine waste: water, rock/ soil. Factors of vegetation growth
in disturbed soil and species selection. Water and wind led soil erosion:
estimation, control and engineering practices. Vegetated water ways and
terraces: functions, types, design. Land forming: Grading and Landscaping
methods. Slope and ground stabilization and monitoring methods. Corporate
Social Responsibility , public involvement in industrial development ,community
development, closure, economic regeneration and regional community
sustainability.
